Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Record Class Resource

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.workshop.mcp.spec.Resource
Record Components:
uri - the unique identifier for the resource, typically a URI
name - a human-readable name for the resource
description - a detailed description of the resource's content and purpose
mimeType - the MIME type of the resource content (e.g., "text/plain", "application/json")
annotations - optional annotations providing additional metadata about the resource
public record Resource(String uri, String name, String description, String mimeType, Annotations annotations) extends Record
Represents a resource that can be accessed through the MCP (Model Context Protocol) system.

Resources are content items that the server makes available to clients, such as files, documents, or data streams. Each resource is identified by a URI and includes metadata about its content type and purpose.

Since:
1.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
